About me

Привіт!

I'm a developer who grew into a tech lead, a researcher who still codes for fun, and a teacher who likes to make things by hand.

Most of my 15 years in tech went into medical software that hospitals and patients rely on every day: I helped build the platform, and built the team behind it and the quality system around it. On the research side, I study how games and gamification can make learning fairer, and I've taught web and database courses at university.

Research & teaching

The PhD, more papers, and the classrooms and communities around them.

PhD defence · March 2027

My PhD · Brno University of Technology

Power Play in Gamified Education: Engineering Adaptive and Fair Information Systems

How gamified assignments can adapt to each student without leaving anyone behind, using dynamic difficulty adjustment, learning analytics and flow. As an Erasmus+ researcher at KU Leuven's e-Media Lab, I also used gamification to teach electric circuits.

Accessibility

Last tested 31 October 2026

I aim for this site to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA. I tested it in Chromium on desktop and at phone sizes, with automated axe-core checks, a contrast check of every text element, keyboard-only use, reflow at 320 px, 200% and 400% zoom, the WCAG text-spacing test, all three text sizes, reduced motion and high-contrast mode, in both light and dark colours.

Built in: a skip link, display settings for text size, colours and animations (the “Aa” button in the menu), visible focus on every link and button, and keyboard access to all of them, including the star. Stitching with the cursor is just for fun and works only with a mouse or touch.

Known gaps: not yet tested with screen readers such as NVDA or VoiceOver, on real phones, or in Safari and Firefox. The “Copied” confirmation isn’t announced, language levels are read out twice, and in Windows high-contrast mode the decorative cross-stitch and the tile backgrounds disappear (all text stays readable).

Found a barrier? Please email me at hello@olena.studio and I’ll fix it.
